def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Boundary overwork grows multiplicatively with tile overhang.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Register spills are a discrete transition to very slow local-memory access.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    # Spill severity is wide-ranged, so compress its extra traffic logarithmically.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[2]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Below the roofline, replicated operand loads directly consume bandwidth.
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
        # A tile whose own intensity misses the roofline remains bandwidth limited.
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[4]
        # The final partially filled wave wastes available bandwidth and issue slots.
        s = s - np.log2(np.maximum(1e-6, 1.0 - f.tail_waste)) * w[5]
    else:
        # Above the roofline, front-end work competing with tensor instructions matters.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[6]
        # Resource pressure reduces resident work and therefore latency hiding.
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[7]
        # Fixed pipeline prologue/epilogue cost is exposed when compute dominates.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[8]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Output-tile overhang is wide-ranging; logarithmically compress wasted work.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Register spills are a discontinuous local-memory failure mode.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    # Spill traffic measures the severity once spilling occurs; compress its wide range.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[2]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # In memory-bound GEMMs, replicated operand loads directly consume bandwidth.
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
        # Low-intensity CTA tiles add bandwidth pressure even when the whole shape is adequate.
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[4]
        # Final-wave idling and K predication waste useful memory transactions and work.
        s = s + f.tail_waste * w[5]
        s = s + f.k_tail_waste * w[6]
        # Parallel split-K partial materialization is especially costly on a bandwidth-bound shape.
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[7]
    else:
        # Compute-bound kernels are limited by issue overhead and tensor-arithmetic efficiency.
        s = s + np.log2(f.instruction_density) * w[8]
        # Resource pressure reduces resident warps and latency hiding for compute pipelines.
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[9]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[10]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[11]
        # Pipeline prologue/epilogue and serial split-K dependencies are exposed against compute.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[12]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[13]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # output-tile overhang: predicated work grows with the boundary waste
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # last-wave underfill leaves whole SMs idle
    s = s + f.tail_waste * w[1]
    # register spilling sends repeatedly accessed values through local memory
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # memory-bound regime: replicated operand loads consume bandwidth
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
        # low-intensity CTA tiles increase bytes per useful operation
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[4]
        # parallel split-K adds global partial-result traffic
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[5]
    else:
        # compute-bound regime: front-end and control instructions steal issue slots
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[6]
        # register allocation pressure reduces latency-hiding residency
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[7]
        # pipeline prologue and epilogue are exposed around short reductions
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[8]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Boundary overcompute grows multiplicatively with the tile overhang.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Convert final-wave idle fraction into its rapidly increasing throughput loss.
    s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[1]
    # A one-wave grid cannot amortize dispatch and scheduling startup.
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[2]
    # Spilling introduces an especially costly local-memory access path.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
    # Pipeline prologue and drain are exposed when the reduction is short.
    s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[5]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # In the bandwidth-bound regime, replicated operand and partial traffic dominate.
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[6]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[7]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[8]
    else:
        # In the compute-bound regime, issue overhead and dependency/resource limits dominate.
        s = s + np.log2(f.instruction_density) * w[9]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[10]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[11]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[12]
    return s
